Jharkhand Foundation Day: kya byurokresi bani vikas men badha? Madhu Koda ne khole 26 sal ke raj
Jharkhand sthapna ke 26 sal pure ho chuke hain, lekin rajy ke vikas ko lekar aaj bhi kaee saval khare hain. kya jharkhand ke vikas ki rah men byurokresi badha bani? kya yojnaon ka labh aam logon tak pahunch paya? aakhir 26 varshon men jharkhand ne kitni tarakki ki aur kin morchon par abhi bhi kam karne ki jarurat hai?
